## Why

I chose a highly ornate, illuminated book on a sculpted stand for *Militantis Ecclesiae*. This single, recognizable subject perfectly embodies Pope Leo XIII's core argument that faith and reason are not enemies but mutually reinforcing. The open book symbolizes "learned defenders of the faith" and "catechisms," the primary remedies advocated to combat "revolution and looseness of doctrine." I rejected abstraction because it could not communicate the specific, critical role of education and theological clarity; a purely symbolic void or shape would lack the necessary, concrete connection to "learned knowledge" and "religiously infused teaching."

## Text-to-image prompt

A high-end physically-based 3D render, in the style of a luxury Cinema 4D / Octane visualization, depicting an open, ornate medieval manuscript on a integrated sculptural plinth, isolated on a completely transparent background. The sculpture is rendered in burnished, ancient bronze and dark, aged gold filigree, capturing an intricate codex. The left page shows complex, embossed sculptural patterns and a central cross symbol (no readable text); the right page displays dense, structured patterns that clearly represent lines of sacred text, rendered with physical depth and gold leaf reflections, unified into a legible, organized book-form. The manuscript rests on a unified bronze stand with integrated architectural motifs and micro-surface textures. The lighting is cinematic and high-contrast, with a dominant key light from the front-left generating sharp specular reflections, profound ambient occlusion in all crevices, and deep shadows across the surface. A subtle rim light from the rear-right carves a sharp, sculptural silhouette. The view is dead-center frontal, mid-height, with an 85mm lens perspective, f/8 aperture, ensuring symmetrical clarity and abundant transparent negative space around the single subject. The material response is ultra-realistic, with procedural imperfections, realistic metal grain, and a profound sense of aged sanctity. There are no other objects, text, lettering, or background environmental elements.
